patches.summary: Added typed Recording model + recordings table + recordings_fts FTS5 index, with QueryRecordings/UpsertRecording APIs.
patches.reason: Backs the seven transcendence commands (lien-chain, surviving-liens, chain-of-title, owner-portfolio, case-arc, enrich, ftl-scan) that operate on a local store of clerk recordings rather than re-fetching live.

patches.summary: Seven hand-coded commands that compose the typed recordings store into property-level analytics.
patches.reason: Public records portals expose only raw search; the underwriter workflow needs lien-chain reconstruction, FL-statute-aware surviving-liens, chain-of-title, owner-portfolio rollup, case-arc, batch enrich, and FTL scans.

patches.summary: Headless-Chromium reCAPTCHA Enterprise v3 token helper (chromedp) wired into the two reCAPTCHA-protected search endpoints via PostSearchWithRecaptcha.
patches.reason: The clerk portal protects /api/home/standardsearch and /api/home/propertysearch with reCAPTCHA Enterprise v3. Tokens are single-use and must originate from the portal's site key — we mint one per call by injecting recaptcha/api.js into a fresh chromedp tab and awaiting grecaptcha.execute.
patches.validated_outcome: search-property --address-no-unit '5600 W 13 AVE' returns 14 deed records end-to-end in ~3s (golden recon case).

patches.summary: auth login --chrome RunE short-circuits under cliutil.IsVerifyEnv() / --dry-run.
patches.reason: validate-narrative and verify harnesses run on machines that have not logged in to the portal in Chrome. Without the short-circuit, full-examples checks fail spuriously on cookie extraction.

patches.summary: findMatchingRelease requires both first AND second party identity and consumes each release at most once.
patches.reason: Two liens sharing only a first-party name (common for repeat borrowers) could both be marked released by a single satisfaction. FL Statute 197.522 / 45.0315 bidder-disclosure rules favor 'still open in doubt'.

patches.summary: enrichParallel honors ctx cancellation between submissions and inside workers; cancelled folios surface error=<ctx.Err()> in their JSONL row.
patches.reason: Without this, SIGINT mid-batch leaves the wait group draining unbounded work after the user gives up.

patches.summary: Domain + cookie path are JSON-encoded before interpolation into the Python -c script.
patches.reason: Profile directory names and cookie paths flow from user input + filesystem state; embedding them raw in a Python string literal would let a profile containing a backslash, quote, or newline break the inline script.

patches.summary: countCookiesForDomain escapes single quotes in the LIKE pattern before interpolating into the sqlite3 SELECT.
patches.reason: The pattern is built from the target domain. Today that's a hardcoded value, but treating every SQL fragment as untrusted keeps the invariant local — future refactors that pass user input into `domain` won't silently open an injection.

patches.summary: FTS index update warning goes to stderr instead of stdout.
patches.reason: sync --json emits JSONL on stdout; a bare warning line on stdout would corrupt the event stream for downstream parsers.
